name: Investor Classification Type 1 Code
definition: Classification of an investor in relation to a corporate action.

ELIG.name: Eligible
ELIG.definition: Investors eligible for participation in the event.

NLIG.name: Non Eligible
NLIG.definition: Investors not eligible for participation in the event.

NQIB.name: Non QIB
NQIB.definition: Investors not eligible for participation in the event under US regulation.

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Investors that may/may not be eligible to participate in the event as described by the issuer.

QUIB.name: QIB
QUIB.definition: Investors eligible for participation in the event as deemed qualified under US regulation.
